title: Superintelligent Retrieval Agent: The Next Frontier of Agentic Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2605.06647v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented agents are increasingly the interface to large knowledge bases, yet most treat retrieval as a black box: they issue exploratory queries, inspect snippets, and reformulate until evidence emerges. This resembles how a newcomer searches an unfamiliar database rather than how an expert navigates it with strong priors about terminology and likely evidence, causing extra retrieval rounds, latency, and poor recall.   We introduce \textit{Superintelligent Retrieval Agent} (SIRA), which casts \emph{superintelligence} in retrieval as compressing multi-round exploratory search into a single corpus-discriminative retrieval action. SIRA does not merely ask which terms are relevant; it asks which terms separate the desired evidence from corpus-level confusers. translated_title: 超级智能检索代理：代理式检索的下一个前沿
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2605.06647v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：检索增强型代理正日益成为大型知识库的接口，但大多数代理将检索视为一个黑箱：它们发出探索性查询，检查片段，并重新表述直到证据出现。这类似于新手搜索不熟悉数据库的方式，而非专家凭借对术语和可能证据的强先验知识进行导航，导致额外的检索轮次、延迟和较差的召回率。我们引入了《超级智能检索代理》（SIRA），它将检索中的“超级智能”定义为将多轮探索性搜索压缩为一次具有语料区分性的检索动作。SIRA不仅询问哪些术语相关，还询问哪些术语能将目标证据与语料级别的干扰项区分开来。在离线阶段，一个大型语言模型为每个文档补充缺失的搜索词汇；在查询时，它预测查询遗漏的证据词汇；语料统计则作为辅助。
tldr: SIRA通过将多轮探索性检索压缩为一次基于语料区分性的检索动作，并利用离线文档词汇丰富和查询时证据词汇预测，显著提升了检索代理的效率和召回率。
en_tdlr: SIRA compresses multi-round exploratory search into a single corpus-discriminative retrieval action, leveraging offline vocabulary enrichment and query-time evidence vocabulary prediction to significantly improve retrieval efficiency and recall.
